newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PRCI values estates at 6.85 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: PRCI values estates at 6.85 bln pesos.

text.p: The Philippine Racing Club Inc said on Friday the management had valued its two real estate properties at 6.850 billion pesos.

The racetrack operator told the Philippine Stock Exchange its 258,294-square-metre (839,456-square-foot) lot at the edge of Manila's Makati business district is worth 6.457 billion pesos, while its 1,571,988-square-metre (5,108,961-square-foot) lot south of Manila has a value of 392.997 million pesos.
The two properties will be exchanged through a property for equity swap with Palawan Consolidated Mining Co.
Under the swap agreement, Palawan will buy the two lots in exchange for its shares at a value of 18 pesos per share. Palawan shares are currently trading at 22 centavos per share.
The agreement still has to be approved by both companies' board of directors and shareholders.
Palawan is majority-owned by banker Edgardo Espiritu, who is planning to develop the two properties into a mixed-use commercial and residential areas.
